title.narrative: Emergency Cash + Livestock Support for drought-affected rural pastoral and agropastoral communities in Hargeisa, Waqooyi-Galbeed, Somaliland

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project aims to alleviate the severe impacts of the ongoing drought affecting rural pastoral and agro-pastoral communities in Hargeisa District, Somaliland. Prolonged dry spells have reduced food availability, livestock productivity, and access to safe water, resulting in increased food insecurity and malnutrition—especially among children under five, pregnant and lactating women, persons with disabilities, and female-headed households. Many families have resorted to negative coping strategies such as distress livestock sales, reduced meal frequency, and migration in search of water and pasture.ltbrgtTo address these needs, the project will implement an integrated “Cash-Plus” emergency response, combining unconditional cash transfers, livestock protection support, emergency water trucking, and community awareness activities. This approach will meet immediate basic needs while protecting essential livelihood assets.ltbrgtProject Componentsltbrgt1. Unconditional Cash Transfers (MPCA)ltbrgt1,800 vulnerable households (approx. 10800 individuals) across 10 drought-affected villages will receive USD 55 per month for three months (Jan 2025–March 2026). The transfer value aligns with the Somalia CWG 2025 CEB Standard (70% of MEB). 2. Livelihood Protection (Livestock Support)ltbrgtEach livestock-keeping household will receive two rounds of 80 kg of quality fodder valued at USD 60 per household for February–March 2026. This support will help maintain livestock body condition, protect core breeding animals, and reduce distress sales. After distribution, 3. Community Awareness and Capacity BuildingltbrgtQuarterly community sessions will promote gender inclusion, social cohesion, and equitable access. Activities will focus on encouraging women’s participation in decision-making and strengthening community support networks among drought-affected groups.ltbrgt4. Emergency Water truckingltbrgtTo address critical water shortages, the project will provide water trucking of 200 water trucker January and 200 trucker February emergency water trucking to the 10 target villages. Water delivery will follow SPHERE standards (30 liters per person per day), with prioritization for women-headed households, ltbrgt2. Strengthening Gender Equality, Inclusion, and Social CohesionltbrgtThe project adheres to ASAL Youth Development Association’s Safe Programming and Protection standards. Women, youth, minority groups, and persons with disabilities will actively participate in consultations, needs verification, and targeting. Protection risks—including GBV, exclusion, and barriers to assistance—will be continuously monitored and mitigated. All project staff and mobilizers will receive PSEA training, and communities will be informed of accessible complaint and reporting channels. Confidential and safe feedback systems will operate throughout the implementation period.ltbrgtOverall ImpactltbrgtBy combining MPCA with livestock protection, community engagement, and emergency water access, the project will stabilize food security, prevent further deterioration into emergency conditions, protect critical livelihoods, and strengthen the resilience and dignity of drought-affected households in rural Hargeisa District.ltbrgtExpected OutcomesltbrgtA. Improved Food Security:ltbrgt1800 households (10800 individuals) enhance purchasing power and meet essential needs.ltbrgtB. Livestock Protection:ltbrgtImproved livestock survival and productivity through timely fodder distribution.ltbrgtC. Women's Leadership:ltbrgtIncreased participation of women in community structures and decision-making.ltbrgtD. Strengthened Resilience:ltbrgtReduced displacement and improved household capacity to cope with recurrent drought shocks.ltbrgtE. Emergency Water trucking: To address critical water shortages, the project will provide 400 Water Tank of emergency water trucking to the 10 target villages.ltbrgtlt/pgt
